{{Otheruses|Supernova}}
'''Supernova''' was a type of beverage which packed a strong "punch" when drank. It was a favorite of the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] on [[Tyne's Horky]] at [[Doodnik's Café]], and was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
